result.title: PLE: Physical-Engineering's Last Exam
result.summary: Frontier language models now score above 90% on popular knowledge benchmarks and are increasingly deployed as agents that carry out multi-hour professional work. Yet no existing benchmark tests whether they can perform the real-world, economically valuable work of a professional physical engineer, such as modelling physics and legal code requirements across a multi-format project corpus, optimising material and installation costs, and issuing 2D/3D engineering design packages that a licensed reviewer would sign off on. Existing engineering benchmarks focus on textbook question answering, isolated tool calls or self-contained toy design problems. As a result, most of these benchmarks are already saturated by leading agents and solving them is far away from delivering real engineering design. We introduce PLE, a benchmark of 85 long-horizon, agentic tasks in professional physical engineering consisting of electrical, civil, structural and mechanical engineering, where solving a task means completing a realistic, billable engineering deliverable. PLE combines two complementary curation paths. Expert-Authored tasks are created end to end by practising engineers from a professional data provider's expert pool. Co-Authored tasks start from problem statements written by practising engineers; an adversarial Creator-Solver agent pipeline constructs each task's realistic project environment, executable grader and reference deliverables before sending them to expert engineers for validation and difficulty intensification. We evaluate a variety of frontier LLMs under seven publicly available agent harnesses. Even the strongest configuration reaches a mean score of only 50.6%, while spending 27M tokens and 63 minutes per task on average, demonstrating the substantial gap between current agents and autonomous physical engineering design.

AI.brief_summary: PLE 是面向职业物理工程师长时程任务的基准，含 85 个电气、土木、结构与机械工程任务，由专家端到端编写并与 Creator-Solver agent 流水线协作构建，再用七种公开 agent harness 评测前沿 LLM。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「多格式项目语料 + 2D/3D 设计交付」可供核查视觉证据筛选与长程状态维持，逐任务 token 与耗时统计也可能为 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的成本–收益与停止决策评价提供参照。
